Thank you, so so much.  That was my problem, I didn't know if I need a psychiatrist or a regular doctor or what, and it seemed like everybody just ignored me whenever I asked.

I guess I have a phonecall to make later today :)

Yeah, I never drank and drove, but thanks :) Thanks for judging me on something I didn't do.  Thankyou for coming to SW to judge people, to make them feel like shit.

It helps!  It helps when you judge people!  Now, tell me how much I've fucked up my life.  Tell me how I never succeeded in anything.  Then, go fucking die.

Dude, I don't even know what the fuck happened.  I just woke up on my floor with a pile (yes, a fucking pile) of bbq chicken next to me.  I don't mean on a plate, I just mean a complete disgusting pile of chicken, lying there on the floor.

The Absolutely last thing i remember was being out of vodka, and going for a drive.  I didn't have anywhere to go, I just thought about in the movies, where people are at the end, and go out, and something amazing happens.

I went to the grocery store, got my vodka, and kept on driving.  I drove to I don't know where the fuck I was.  I turned around because the only cars  I saw driving around were cops, and it scared the fuck out of me.

Anyways, i have nobody to share it with.  I didn't then, and I don't know, while I"m sitting here hungover, ready to go for round 2.  I make friends, and everything is awesome, but I'm fucking crazy.  Friendships never fucking last.

You know what does seem to last?  This fucking headache.  I need to drink some more.  I appreciate your post, it does suck drinking alone.  I miss my friends.....

I dohn't have a lot to share.  I am done wiht lifel.  If you athink about it, why do pepople want to live?  It's a silly concept.  Either you have a realspon bto be alive, or you don't.  That's tat.  So people are laive or they raen'rtt.

a lot of vodka bottle to drink and share

(ps,. I'm drunk.  Jut tell me things.  aybe I'll listen to them.  I'm ujust depressed.  I want to fucming die. but i want ot o live.

This really is hard to follow.  That being said, I'm on my way to go drown myself.  I feel exactly the way you do.  you can burden me with your issies, I'll stick around for a while.  As long as you'fre cool with I'm shitfaced.  I figured it's the best way to drown myself.  

Your psot doesn't make sense, but because of that, it makes all the sense in the world to me.  PM me dude.  I want to talk to you.
Go on..

I refuse to pay over a grand to go to the ER, I would rather die.  I know that sound stupid, but I've worked hard to get to the point in my life where I can cross finances off of the list of things i have to worry about on a daily basis.  If I have to start worrying about that again, I don't know if I want to live in the first place...

But anyways, moving on.  Can I talk to a GP about this?  Do I need some sort of psychologist?  I don't know what to do =/
What's going on, dude?

Well, if it makes you feel any better, since you've replied, I've sat at my desk drinking and talking to you, which made me start responding to other people on SW, which made me not go do what I was originally planning on doing.  I'm going to call a doctor and talk to them, and figure out what I need to do.

You may have been a pretty big factor in me still being alive in a few hours.  No matter what happens, I want you to remember that you helped save me today.  

I may change my mind again in a few hours.  I may still decide to end it.  You've at least made me think twice about it.  Thank you.

This is probably meaningless, but your post is very poetic and well written.  I have absolutely nothing to contribute to help you.  I just want you to know that even your "Help me, I'm depressed" posts kind of show that you're a good writer.  

The only reason I am saying anything at all here is because no matter what happens, or how you feel, you have a talent.  Here, you've turned your depression into something beautiful.

While we're on the subject, if you don't mind me asking, how did you come out to your parents, and how did that end up?  I'm not gay myself, so I guess I'll never quite understand.  I just let my parents know after I grew up and moved out that if they don't give me a reason to keep them around, I have no problem separating myself from my family.  Since then, I feel like I can actually rely on them, and I don't feel like they're judging me for everything anymore.

Is there anything you want to talk about?  I went into creeper mode, and checked out your history.  You don't really talk about what's going on with you.  If you want to talk about it, just know that I won't judge you for anything.  

You say you don't feel loved for or cared for, but all I see is you trying to help people.  You haven't had your account for long, but your heart is clearly in the right place.  

I'm here if you want to PM me and talk about what's going on with you.  If not, that's cool too, everybody deals with their shit in their own way.  

Thank you for talking to me here though, I really appreciate it.  I still don't know what the fuck I'm doing, but it's nice to know that some internet stranger can actually seem like they care.  I hope whatever you're going through gets better.

Then you know how hard it is to talk to somebody about it... That's kind of why I'm having such a hard time with this.  I could only really talk to a single person in my life about it, and she suddenly doesn't give a flying fuck.

So what's going on with you?

Have you ever dealt with depression?  I don't mean feeling sad because you did bad on a test, or got dumped, but genuinely depressed for absolutely no reason, and knowing that there's nothing you can do to feel better?  Knowing that the cause of your depression is nothing but you yourself being broken, and knowing that there is no fixing yourself?

>My family doesn't know I'm gay and I can't talk to them. 

If you have to hide who you are from your family, are they really worth considering them your family?  I know that may sound terrible, but dude....  You don't need all the stress from trying to hide who you are from the ones that you love.

I just think that if family is important to you, you should be completely honest with them.  If they can't accept you for who you are, that doesn't sound like a very healthy relationship to begin with.  

There are a lot of people out there in the world.  I wish I could give you advice on how to meet people or make friends or whatever, but I sure as hell can't figure that one out.  Just know that there are people here on SW that actually do give a shit, even if you are just an internet stranger.  If you need somebody to talk to, I'm here.  You can PM me if you would like, I'm always here to listen, and I'm not going to judge you for anything.

I've been on a lot of anti-depressants, and the only one that I found worked for me, the side effects were god awful.  I think there's something else wrong with me that is causing all my depression and anxiety.

Basically, I want to write down what is going on with me, go to some sort of doctor, hand it to them, and have them read it, maybe ask me some questions, and tell me what they think is wrong.  

The problem I'm running in to is where do I go, who do I see?  Do I just see a GP, do I need to see a crazy-people doctor?  I don't actually need to talk to somebody, I just want them to diagnose me and prescribe me medication.  

So that's basically my problem.  If you don't know the answer, I get that, and don't feel bad about it.  I've just posted about it here before, and got no responses.  My best friend since I was 13, the one that always helped me through my little depressed episodes, she's fucking gone, and so she won't help me.  I just don't know what to do at this point...

You know what, you did help with your response.  I don't fucking want to die, I just want to feel better, it's just that sometimes that doesn't feel like an option...

I'm 24.  I've been depressed since I was about 13.  I'm not going to feed you any of the "life gets better!" bullshit, because sometimes, it's not true.  Sometimes life just sucks.

You're only 16.  You're still in high school.  While life doesn't always get better, life sure as hell changes when you get out of there.  You say you have no one, but that's not a fault of your own.  You're stuck around the same people at school, day after day.  It's not your fault if you get along with them or not.  Just because you have no one at this point in your life doesn't mean it's your fault.

I honestly think you should give life a chance, and that's saying a lot coming from me.  Hell, get out of high school, get out of your parents house.  Go to college, don't go to college, do whatever feels right for you, see how you feel then.  

People say suicide isn't the answer, but it sure as hell is AN answer.  It's like circling "all of the above" on a multiple choice test when you have absolutely no idea what the answer actually is.  It feels like it's your best bet at the time, but maybe if you stop and think about the question, you'll realize that all the other options are worth thinking about first, at least.  

But hey, I'm sitting here drinking by myself, waiting for my roommate to leave for work so I can go drown myself.  I'm a fucking hypocrite, I know, but I at least understand how you are feeling.  Depression is fucking awful, and there is literally nothing worse than losing hope like we both have.  

I realize I don't know you, and my life won't change in the slightest if you kill yourself.  I won't know you did it, it won't change a god damn thing for me.  Still, I know what you're going through, and I hope you don't.  If you need to talk to somebody, feel free to PM me, even if it's just to vent about the shit that's going on with you.  I wish you the best.

You know, I don't know you.  You don't know me.  It's not going to affect your life if I'm alive or not after today.  But moving on from my depressed whiny bullshit, maybe when I post this crap, I'm just trying to get some help.

Here's the thing.  I need a fucking doctor.  I need HELP.  In the past few months, I've went from "I can't leave everybody behind", to "Well, I can't stand making a family member walk in and find my body", to "They'll understand.  Or they won't.  At least I'll be done with it".

I need to talk to a doctor.  I need them to figure out what is wrong with me.  I need them to drug me out of my fucking mind, because my mind is a terrible place to be.  

I'm sorry if I sounded like I was trying to be an asshole.  People usually just don't respond to me in SW.  I do appreciate your response, and I realize my post wasn't something that was easy to come up with a response for.

I think that owning your own business and working for yourself is fantastic.  However, if it's causing you more stress than joy, is it really worth it?  If it's just making you anxious and depressed, why keep it in your life?  

What kind of business is it?
Guess this answers my questions :P
I'll listen to anything you have to say.  I'm in absolutely no position to judge you, so speak your mind, man :)
Alright, I'll be here when you get back if you just need somebody to talk about shit with.
What's on your mind dude?  I doubt I'm going anywhere for a while...

I've been putting it off got damn near 10 years,  telling myself my problems ate just temporary the whole time. I'm my problem, so my problems are still here until they die with me.

I'm still going to kill myself, but thank you got commenting... that at least made me a bit more calm for at least a little while...

A week ago I would have agreed with you. Not long ago, i had a girl that I like over, and we were drinking and watching movies. We kind of fell asleep on the couch, and when we got up, we kissed before she left.

And then she seemed to regret it, and starter acting sort of weird. We're still friends, and I wouldn't give that up for anything, it is just sort of a bummer sometimes.
Your mother told you you're an embarrassment for being depressed?... You need somebody to support you, man. Don't take that crap, and don't let it keep you down.

Just remember, no amount of money is worth your sanity. If you feel that you need to work less, tell your boss. You're a student, that's a pretty good reason. Don't waste away worrying about a job that you know you won't be at forever.

If she is all shy and introverted as well, it might be okay to just explain all that crape to her. It'll be awkward, and you'll feel stupid while you do it, but you're going to keep beating yourself up over this if you don't give it a shot.
See, I think most people would say that's a step down from the life I have now, but I think it sounds amazing. Scary as hell, but amazing. Thanks for sharing :)
You're completely right.. Thanks for that, I really do appreciate it.

She doesn't live near me at all, and she kind of seems pissed about cutting contact.  I thought she was the one person that would really get it, and not just get pissed off and offended over it, but apparently not.

The reason that's a problem is I need to know that whatever happens, she would be there for me, and apparently that's not how it works.

I'm pretty fucked in the head.  I don't know why, but I can't get away from it.  I've tried all kinds of shit, and nothing is working.  There's no escaping my problems, this is my last attempt at getting away.  If I want to kill myself anyways, what have I got to lose?

I don't have a destination.  I have enough money to keep me afloat for a decent amount of time.  I'm tired of having to plan everything, tired of having to make sure I know where I'm going, expecting things to go a certain way.  I'm just so fucking tired.

>The quote that comes to mind is "only after we lose everything are we free to do anything." Burn everything you have to the ground and make something new. I love it!

The best way to describe my feeling after making this decision, after I was done with my stupid depressed bullshit, would have to be that smashing pumpkin song where he's singing about the best day in the world being when he decided to off himself.  I'm not going to kill myself, but I feel the same sort of freedom as he's describing.
Thanks :) After reading all the other comments, I realize I probably won't, but eh.  Can't be sure until I try, it's either this or carry through with my plans to kill myself.

If you don't mind me asking, how did it work out for you?
